decision: STOP the proposed full fitting campaign. Preserve this preflight as a failed acquisition-feasibility checkpoint, not a negative result for multiple operating points or the original near-flutter task.
critical_findings: The exact .080928 missing-input floor decisively forecloses the expanded-grid all-frame target for this representation. Its entire contribution comes from newly introduced, severely supercritical cases. It says nothing comparable about the original margin population, where the reported missing-group floor is zero.

My universal absolute-grid proposal created this population problem. With the supplied training range, keeping every design inside m∈[−.03,.22] would require a common speed both≥.78×2071.1506≈1615.50m/s and≤1.03×1198.7415≈1234.70m/s. That intersection is empty. This is a constraint on this acquisition design—not an information impossibility theorem.

Numerical convergence and same-equation ROM agreement are satisfactory evidence of computational execution, not validation of1875m/s² freestream acceleration under instantaneous piston theory. Mach≥2 alone does not establish that applicability.

The .9*ucrit eigensystem initializer is matched across arms, so it does not alone invalidate the paired simulated intervention. It does limit interpretation to that prepared state distribution; robustness to physically realizable excitation remains untested.

Clean boundary windows contain three accepted observations, so the requested information contrast exists there. Neither waveform contrast nor zero collision floor establishes signed-margin usefulness.
